newsitem.title: USA: Holly Holdings gets casino financing.
newsitem.headline: Holly Holdings gets casino financing.

text.p: Holly Holdings said it recieved received an initial private placement financing of $10 million to be provided though U2 consulting, a unit of Pacific Telesis group, to break ground on its first hotel and casino.
Holly Holdings said it has a firm financing committment up to a total of $65 million that will be provided as required to correspond with the requirements of the construction schedule.
The company said Pacific Genesis Group will raise the money through a corporate debt offering of five year notes.
Country World Casinos, a Holly majority owned subsidiary, will run the operation in Black Hawk, Colorado.
Holly Holdings president, William Patrowicz told Reuters, "The casino will be the largest in the state with room for 1,800 slot machines and the hotel will have 250-300 rooms."
